lines.speaker: Zi
lines.text: You've been sitting here a while.
lines.monologue: He looks smaller when he's not pretending to be fine.

lines.speaker: Caelan
lines.text: Just... trying to remember something. It was right there, and then it wasn't.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.text: You don't have to chase it. Sometimes things come back on their own.
lines.monologue: I don't know if that's true. But it's what I needed to hear once.

lines.text: [Caelan seems a little more at ease.]
